headline: Netflix (NFLX) Eyes Letterboxd To Bring 30 Million Movie Fans Into Its Orbit
summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) is reportedly in talks to acquire Letterboxd, a movie-focused social network with over 30 million users. The potential deal would bring a large and active film community directly into Netflix’s ecosystem. Discussions are ongoing and center on how a social platform could support content discovery, engagement, and future product ideas.
